title: EndpointsListResult
description: Result of the endpoints.list JSON-RPC method — every configured AI endpoint (design §4.5.4, ADR-0030). This schema is the SINGLE declaration of the endpoint shape: endpoints.create and endpoints.update reference its $defs cross-file, exactly as the git.* results reference git.status's. The credential is the stored credentialRef mapped to a renderer row handle (secrow:...) — null when no key is set, NEVER the reference itself (ADR-0017 §1, nocx-jb20.1).

endpoints.description: Every stored endpoint. Never null: an empty list is [] (nocx-25k9.14).

id.description: Backend-minted identity: endpoint:custom:<slug>:<uuid>. The renderer may hold it but never mints it.

name.description: The display name the picker shows.

baseUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL. Parse-level validated only this pass; the loopback/private policy is nocx-edio (design §4.5).

schema.description: The wire schema, a closed enum: 'openai-compatible' is the ONE value this pass knows (design §4.5, decision 2). A select in the UI appears when the second value does.

noKey.description: True only when the person explicitly declared that this endpoint needs no API key. False preserves the credential-required default; this is not inferred from the URL.

credential.description: Row handle (secrow:...) of the endpoint's own vault secret, or null when no key is set (created without one, or the key was deleted on the Secrets page). A reference never crosses the wire.

models.description: One or more models the endpoint offers. Never null: an endpoint without models is invalid.

name.description: The model id the API understands.

alias.description: The picker label, or null to show the model id.

headers.description: The endpoint's custom HTTP headers (nocx-lyyk), sent on every request it makes. Never null: an endpoint with no custom headers sends []. Each row names a header and carries EXACTLY ONE value source: a literal value, or the row handle (secrow:...) of a vault secret — never the material, and never the reference itself (ADR-0017 §1).

name.description: The header name. Refused names (Authorization, Host, Content-Length, Content-Type, the hop-by-hop set) are rejected at write time with the reason.

value.description: The literal header value, or null when the value is a vault secret. An empty literal is legal HTTP and stays "".

secret.description: Row handle of the vault secret the value resolves to at request time, or null for a literal value. A reference never crosses the wire.
